Industry challenges

## Legacy personalization tools are failing your visitors and your teams.

01Results don’t keep pace02Platforms can't keep up03Teams need new tools

01

### Results don’t keep pace with costs.

Your personalization experience is broken. Customer acquisition costs are up 40% since 2023, yet most users see the same generic experience and will bounce before relevance kicks in.

95%

Generic experiences

Visitors see substantially the same site regardless of intent.

![Mobile phone displaying shoes](https://framerusercontent.com/images/VuYEFM2R72FpyU0JHSTJhtEzs.png?width=1332&height=1779)

02

### Current platforms can't keep up.

Legacy engines – even the ones using LLMs – rely on batch updates and static rankings. They update overnight, not in-session, leading to a stale homepage and product grid. Even when intent is obvious, business users can't act in real time.

24h

Update latency

Legacy engines update overnight, not in-session.

![Shopping funnel](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Y4ttIh9EKX74RFYlKe3xu8wk84.png?width=1356&height=1797)

03

### Business teams need new tools.

With static rules and hardcoded logic, merchandisers and marketers are stuck. They can’t push new products, prioritize SKUs, or respond to trends in real-time — because legacy platforms weren't built to be agile.

5%

Team reach

Manual merchandising touches a small fraction of sessions.

![Web analytics](https://framerusercontent.com/images/uDhpe8yMaWDr3arlANhwrUO3c.png?width=1356&height=1869)

## Curious where you land?

See exactly where your search, recs, and merchandising break down for a shopper who’s never seen your site before.

### Vector AI profiles.

Without requiring login, Malachyte uses Vector AI to create and update a profile for each user that assesses both intent in session and general preferences over time — continuously improving personalization with every search, hover, click, and scroll.

Real-time signals like search terms, device type, location, and traffic source flow into the profile, increasing relevance and personalization.

### Multi-surface personalization.

Malachyte personalizes the entire customer journey — from homepage to search results, collection pages, and product detail pages.

Both in session and across multiple surfaces, each interaction builds on the last, creating a seamless, dynamic journey that adapts to user preference and intent.
